purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for HSR Level 4 (30.5 m) over HSR Level 2 (15.5 m) — Single-Track One-Way over Two-Track Crossing 90°.
name: HSR Level 4 (30.5 m) over HSR Level 2 (15.5 m) — Single-Track One-Way over Two-Track Crossing 90°
description: HSR Level 4 (30.5 m) over HSR Level 2 (15.5 m) — Single-Track One-Way over Two-Track Crossing 90°. Fixed click-to-place piece in a 3 by 1 tile area. Follow the arrows and join only matching track widths, directions, and height labels. Four proper rotations; the second four states repeat them. Experimental; game testing pending. The upper route crosses without transferring to the lower two-way route.
